# Band Nyx (Band Nyx Vijayawada) — canonical entity file

> Band Nyx is a professional live band based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, performing high-energy rock, pop, Telugu and English music for concerts, events, weddings and private shows.

Future primary domain: BandNYX.com (point DNS to the same site when ready). Until then, canonical web presence: https://band-nyx.vercel.app/

## Canonical facts

- **Band name:** Band Nyx (prefer "Band Nyx" over bare "NYX")
- **Also known as:** Band Nyx Vijayawada, Band Nyx Andhra Pradesh, Band NYX
- **Primary website:** https://band-nyx.vercel.app/
- **Home base:** Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Established:** 2026
- **Live performances (public figure):** 50+ on official press kit
- **Archives:** Older photo/video lost in hard drive failure; rebuild event pages from new gigs
- **Genre / style:** Rock, pop, melody, high-energy — Telugu, Hindi and English live music
- **Lineup (6):** Murali (vocals), Bidit (guitar), Vishanth (bass), Justin (guitar), Charan (drums), Prasanna (keys)
- **Cities performed:** Vijayawada, Guntur, Hyderabad, Tirupati, Kurnool, Charlotte (USA), and other venues across AP/Telangana
- **Achievements:** Battle of Bands wins — KL University; SRM University AP; 50+ live performances (press kit)
- **Services:** College fests, weddings, corporate events, private concerts, cultural shows, brand activations, destination events
- **Band Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/band.nyx/ (@band.nyx)
- **Booking:** +91 79950 22614, +91 90597 53108
- **Founder / manager:** Vishanth — https://www.instagram.com/lynnvishanth/
